findings.issue: Image cleanup on deletion not implemented
findings.description: When projects or qualifications are deleted, their Supabase images are left orphaned. No deletion endpoint exists. Supabase storage will accumulate stale files over time, incurring unnecessary costs.

findings.issue: Bucket existence and permissions not validated
findings.description: checkSupabaseConfig() validates env vars are present but does not test bucket readability/accessibility. Upload failures due to invalid bucket name or permission denials will surface as 500 errors with raw Supabase messages, not as clear 503 config errors. A test upload on startup would make this obvious immediately.
